run: 2026-10-20, 2 x Standard_B2s, ledger 3 replicas via Argo Rollouts, ~2.5 req/s closed-loop client from the loadgen pod
method: Fault times taken from cluster events (pod Killing, Chaos Mesh Applied/Recovered), not from when the experiment was submitted. Client-side request log from the loadgen pod.

experiments.name: pod-kill-one
experiments.verdict: confirmed (1 of 122 requests in the 45 s window around the kill)

experiments.name: pod-kill-all
experiments.verdict: confirmed, with a large margin: replacement pods started 2 s after the kill, and each passed Kyverno signature verification at admission

experiments.name: latency-400ms
experiments.hypothesis: requests succeed but most exceed the 250 ms SLO threshold
experiments.verdict: confirmed, and worse than predicted: every request was slow, and a closed-loop client's throughput fell about 63%. p50 is about 2x the injected delay because several packet exchanges per request are each delayed.

caveats: The first version of scripts/game-day.ps1 reported MTTR of 24 s and 31 s. Those figures included Chaos Mesh's 18-28 s injection lag and were wrong. It also reported 26.5% slow requests for the latency run because it averaged fault and non-fault time and a sequential client under-samples slow periods. Corrected figures are above; the script is being fixed to use event times.
Single run, single cluster, one client. Treat these as indicative, not statistically meaningful.
The error counts are from a closed-loop client at about 2.5 requests per second, so one failed request corresponds to roughly 400 ms of exposure.
